AdminAuth.loginSubtitle: For store managers and staff only.
AdminAuth.mfaSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
AdminAuth.mfaCodeHint: Lost your phone? Enter one of your backup codes instead.
AdminAuth.setupSubtitle: Admins must use an authenticator app. This takes about a minute.
AdminAuth.setupStep1: Install an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Aegis.
AdminAuth.setupStep2: In the app, add an account and scan this QR code.
AdminAuth.setupStep3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
AdminAuth.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
AdminAuth.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key manually
AdminAuth.backupCodesHelp: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe and private. They are shown only now.
AdminAuth.alreadyEnabled: Two-factor sign-in is already on for your account.
